source.section: Form NJ-1040 lines 15, 16a, 27, 29, 30, 38, 39, 42, 43: Instr PDF p.21 line 27, PDF p.22 line 29, PDF p.8 lines 6-7 (regular and senior 65+ exemptions), PDF p.9 line 13, PDF p.25 line 30, PDF p.27 lines 38-39, PDF p.33 lines 42-43, PDF p.65 Tax Rate Schedules

worked: Federal AGI 60,000.00 (wages 58,000.00 + interest 2,000.00); federal taxable income = 60,000.00 - 15,750.00 federal standard deduction = 44,250.00 (given, not tested; the federal senior deduction is ignored). Line 15 wages 58,000.00 + line 16a taxable interest 2,000.00 = line 27 total income 60,000.00 (the projection: federal AGI 60,000.00 less taxable Social Security 0.00). Lines 28a-28c: none (age 45, no pension); exclusions 0.00. Line 29 New Jersey gross income = 60,000.00 - 0.00 - 0.00 = 60,000.00. Line 30 exemptions (line 13): regular 1,000 x 1 (nobody is 65 or older, so no senior exemption) = 1,000.00; line 38 = 1,000.00 (no other deductions). Line 39/42 taxable income = 60,000.00 - 1,000.00 = 59,000.00. Line 43 tax, rate schedule Table A (single/separate) as bands: 20,000.00 x 0.014 = 280.00 + 15,000.00 x 0.0175 = 262.50 + 5,000.00 x 0.035 = 175.00 + 19,000.00 x 0.05525 = 1,049.75 = 1,767.25. The booklet's Tax Table (taxable income under 100,000) gives 1,769 for the 59,000-59,050 row (schedule at the midpoint 59,025, rounded); expected keeps the exact schedule result. No credits. State income tax = 1,767.25.
accepted_approximations: Tax Table: for taxable income under 100,000 New Jersey uses its Tax Table, the schedule's tax at each 50-dollar row's midpoint rounded to the dollar; the projection uses the exact schedule.
